platform.description: auto, openshift or kubernetes. auto detects OpenShift by its image.openshift.io API; set it when rendering without a cluster.

tag.description: Image tag. Empty means the chart's appVersion.

postprocess.description: The image the postprocess Job runs.

tag.description: Image tag. Empty means the chart's appVersion.

discovery.description: The aibom-discovery init container's image. Needs python3 and bash. Empty uses OpenShift AI's runtime-pytorch image where OpenShift AI is installed, and a digest-pinned pytorch/pytorch image otherwise. Setting repository requires tag.

tag.description: Image tag. Required when repository is set.

pullPolicy.description: Pull policy for the webhook image. Empty leaves it to Kubernetes.

resources.description: Webhook container resource requests and limits.

provider.description: service-ca (OpenShift's built-in service CA), cert-manager, or auto: service-ca on OpenShift, cert-manager elsewhere.

certManager.description: cert-manager settings, used only when tls.provider resolves to cert-manager.

issuerName.description: Issuer the chart creates and uses.

renewBefore.description: Renew this long before expiry, e.g. 720h.

failurePolicy.description: What the API server does when the webhook is unreachable. Ignore lets pods through uninstrumented.

namespaceSelectorLabel.description: Label a namespace must carry to opt in.

trustedJobControllerIdentity.description: Username the cluster's Job controller creates pods as, e.g. system:serviceaccount:kube-system:job-controller. Verify it on your cluster before setting it.

networkPolicy.description: NetworkPolicy letting the API server reach the webhook.

build.description: In-cluster image builds with an OpenShift BuildConfig (OpenShift only).

gitRef.description: Branch, tag or commit the build checks out.

enabled.description: Run the watcher. Without it no AIBOMs are compiled.

finalizerCleanup.description: Post-delete hook that strips the watcher's finalizers on uninstall.

url.description: Prometheus or Thanos Querier URL. Unset means Thanos Querier on OpenShift and none elsewhere. Empty disables telemetry.

monitoringAccess.description: Prometheus read access for the postprocess ServiceAccount.

clusterRole.description: ClusterRole to bind. Empty means cluster-monitoring-view on OpenShift and none elsewhere.

registryLookup.description: Read image labels from the image's registry when there's no Image object. Makes outbound requests to registries.

keepPostprocessJobs.description: Keep finished postprocess Jobs and their input ConfigMaps.

telemetryAllPods.description: Query telemetry for pods with no detected GPU.
